title: Genome Sequencing Now Costs Just $525
hook: Genome sequencing now costs just 525 dollars.
closing: Reading DNA is no longer the hard part; understanding what it means is.
question: Would you sequence your whole genome?

segments.say: Genome sequencing now costs 525 dollars. A once-unreachable test is approaching routine medical pricing.
The old budget now buys 180,952 genomes. Falling costs transformed one research project into population-scale testing.
Modern genome sequencing takes about 1 day. The bottleneck moved from reading DNA to interpreting it.
